title: Henry12Week
author: Joe S.
desc:
All accessories: Double progression — add reps first, then weight. Hit top of rep range across all sets for 2 sessions → add smallest increment.					
Myo-rep sets (Phase 3 ★): Activation set near failure → 3–5 mini sets of 3–5 reps with 10–15s rest.					
RIR autoregulation (Dr. Mike): Rate every set. If 3+ RIR, go heavier. If 0 RIR too early, reduce load.					
Deload weeks (4/8/11): Same exercises, ~50% volume, 60–65% load. Do not try to progress.
